_comment: The part catalog. Every part the game knows about lives here. mass is in kg. buoyancy is how many kg of weight the part can hold up when fully under water (more than its mass = it floats). A propeller's steer is how many degrees it swivels when you steer, and air is how much of its push it keeps out of the water (0.2 = a fifth). An engine's fuel_use is how much fuel it burns per second at full throttle. A fuel tank's capacity is how much fuel it holds. The seat's reserve_fuel is a little can under the seat, used only when the vehicle has no fuel tank at all. Add a new part by copying one and changing the numbers.
